from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); pts=set()
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); pts.add((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,pts))
    return out

def _l(pts):
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    if len(pts)<5: return None
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if pts==({(r,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)}|{(y,c) for y in range(r0,r1+1)}):
                return r,c,(1 if r==r0 else -1),(1 if c==c0 else -1)
    return None

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(grid,bg)
    ms=[(len(p),color,p,_l(p)) for color,p in comps if _l(p)]
    if not ms: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,mc,mp,(r,c,vd,hd)=max(ms,key=lambda x:x[0])
    cand=[]
    for color,p in comps:
        if color==mc or _l(p): continue
        cy=sum(y for y,x in p)/len(p)
        if (cy-r)*(-vd)<=0: continue
        r0=min(y for y,x in p); r1=max(y for y,x in p)
        c0=min(x for y,x in p); c1=max(x for y,x in p)
        dy=max(r0-r,0,r-r1); dx=max(c0-c,0,c-c1)
        cand.append((dy+dx,-len(p),p))
    if not cand: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=min(cand,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))[2]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in target: out[y][x]=mc
    return out
